items.title: Why Airbnb (ABNB) Stock Is Up Today
items.summary: Shares of online accommodations platform Airbnb (NASDAQ:ABNB) jumped 15.1% in the afternoon session after the company delivered a strong second-quarter that beat all estimates across the board and raised its full-year guidance. The company reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of $3.61 billion, a 16.5% year-over-year increase that beat analyst estimates of $3.58 billion.
